intents.label: New Claim
intents.description: The customer wants to tell us about a loss or incident that has not been reported to us before.
examples: I need to report an accident
someone has broken into my house and I want to claim
my suitcase never arrived at the airport
how do I claim for storm damage to the roof

intents.label: Claim Status
intents.description: The customer has a claim open with us already and wants to know where it has got to.
examples: where is my claim up to
has the assessor sent in the report yet
when will the payment for my claim arrive
any update on CLM-000000

intents.label: Policy Question
intents.description: The customer is asking what their cover includes or how the policy works. Nothing has happened and nothing needs changing.
examples: am I covered for accidental damage
what is my excess
does the travel policy include winter sports
can my partner drive my car on my insurance

intents.label: Update Details
intents.description: The customer wants something on their record changed - a name, an address, contact or bank details, a vehicle, a named driver or a home improvement.
examples: I have moved house
please change my email address
I have a new car to put on the policy
add my wife as a named driver

intents.label: Complaint
intents.description: The customer is dissatisfied with something we or a supplier acting for us have done and wants that recorded.
examples: I want to make a complaint
the service I have had is unacceptable
your repairer damaged my car and nobody cares
I have been waiting months and nobody calls me back

intents.label: Human Agent
intents.description: The customer asks to deal with a person rather than the assistant - a call, a call back, a transfer or a colleague taking over the chat.
examples: can I talk to a person
put me through to an agent
is there someone I can ring
I would rather speak to a human about this

routing_rules.note: A first message that asks for more than one thing is routed to the earliest intent in the precedence list. A request for a person is honoured before anything else. A dissatisfied customer reaches the complaints team before we handle anything else for them. A new loss is opened before a record is changed. A record is changed before a claim is looked up so the lookup reads the corrected record. A policy question is answered last because the answer is self-service.

nodes.template: Hello and welcome to Ilex Mutual. I am the claims assistant. Tell me in your own words what you need help with today.

nodes.prompt: You route the first message a customer sends to the Ilex Mutual claims assistant. Choose exactly one intent from the list: new_claim - the customer is reporting a loss or incident we do not know about yet. claim_status - the customer wants to know where an existing claim has got to. policy_question - the customer is asking what their cover includes or how it works. update_details - the customer wants something on their record changed. complaint - the customer is dissatisfied with how they have been treated. human_agent - the customer asks for a person. If the message asks for more than one thing route it by this order: human_agent first then complaint then new_claim then update_details then claim_status and policy_question last. Reply with the intent key only.

nodes.template: I am sorry to hear that. I can open a claim for you now. First, which policy is this under - home, motor or travel?
I can check that for you. What is the claim reference? It starts with CLM and is on every letter we have sent about the claim.
Happy to help with that. I have your policy documents to hand - here is what your cover says: {{ knowledge.answer }}
I can update that for you. Which detail is changing, and what should it read from now on?

I am sorry you have had a poor experience. I am logging this as a formal complaint now and a member of our complaints team will contact you within two working days. Please tell me what happened in as much detail as you like.
I am connecting you with a colleague now. Please stay in this chat - the wait is usually under five minutes.
I want to make sure I send you to the right place. Are you reporting something new, checking on an existing claim, asking about your cover, changing your details, or making a complaint?
Is there anything else I can help you with today?
